def test_compare_one():
    # Numeric values
    assert compare_one(10, 20) == 20
    assert compare_one(20, 10) == 20
    assert compare_one(-5, -2) == -2

    # Equal values
    assert compare_one(10, 10) is None
    assert compare_one("10", 10) is None

    # String values
    assert compare_one("12.5", "10.5") == "12.5"
    assert compare_one("10.5", "12.5") == "12.5"

    # Decimal commas
    assert compare_one("12,5", "10,5") == "12,5"
    assert compare_one("1,5", 2) == 2

    # The original value and type are returned
    result = compare_one("3", 2)
    assert result == "3"
    assert isinstance(result, str)
